subject: MAP Kickoff: Acme Health POC / Evaluation Plan and Owners
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Liu <natalie.liu@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP Kickoff: Acme Health POC / Evaluation Plan and Owners

Hi Natalie / Tom —

Great to get the POC moving. Per our call, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan so everyone is aligned on scope, success criteria, and who owns each piece of the evaluation. Attached is a one-page MAP and an initial evaluation checklist we can iterate on.

High-level goals for the POC (2 weeks):
- Validate integration of Redwood inference into Acme Health triage pipeline (API + auth).
- Benchmark latency and throughput against your 95th-percentile SLA (target p95 < 350ms for 512-token requests).
- Evaluate answer quality on your clinical triage prompts (human pass rate >= 85%, hallucination incidents < 5%).
- Measure cost per 1k tokens and present optimization recommendations.

Proposed owners (please flag changes):
- Acme PM / stakeholder: Natalie Liu — product acceptance, success criteria sign-off, participant of demo.
- Prompt & dataset owner: Tom Alvarez (Acme) — provide 150 representative prompts and expected outputs.
- Technical owner (integration & infra): Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood) — API keys, network setup, sample client.
- Commercial / contract: Rafael Mendes (Redwood) — scope, timeline, invoice/credits.
- CS / onboarding: Priya Natarajan (Redwood) — runbooks, eval tooling, retrospective.

Initial benchmark plan (week 1):
1) Data prep: Acme provides prompt set + acceptance examples (Tom) — target 150-200 prompts covering edge cases.
2) Baseline run: Redwood runs inference against open-model baseline and records latency/cost/quality.
3) Redwood will run candidate models/quantization profiles and produce comparison report (latency, token cost, pass rate).
4) Human review: small cohort (5 reviewers) to label hallucinations / safety flags for 50 high-risk prompts.

Timeline / checkpoints:
- Mar 9 EOD: Acme provides prompt set + 3 sample integration calls.
- Mar 11: Redwood baseline report shared; quick sync to review results.
- Mar 15: Demo with product stakeholders — pass/fail decision on next steps.

Next steps for today: Natalie / Tom — can you confirm the dataset owner and expected delivery date for prompts? I attached the MAP PDF and a checklist (placeholders) — we can iterate.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth run.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

Attachments: Acme_POC_MAP_v1.pdf (1 page MAP), evaluation_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Liu <natalie.liu@acmehealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP Kickoff: Acme Health POC / Evaluation Plan and Owners

Thanks Marissa — quick technical additions from our side.

Notes on integration and benchmarking:
- We will provide a small client library (Python) that hits the Redwood hosted endpoint and emits token-level timing. Expect a sample repo link in the Drive folder by EOD.
- For realistic latency, please include typical payload sizes (we used median ~220 tokens and 95th ~600 tokens in similar customers).
- We will run both streaming and non-streaming modes; please indicate which mode your product will use for the triage UX.
- Security: if you need VPC peering for private evaluation or allowlisting, Rafael and I can scope this; otherwise standard API key is fine for the POC.

Technical acceptance criteria (proposal):
- p95 latency < 350ms for 512-token standard; p50 < 120ms.
- Error rate (5xx) < 0.5% over test window.
- Throughput: sustain 20 req/s on a single dedicated instance for the longest sequence length.

I can take ownership of running the model candidates and producing the latency/cost tables; Priya will coordinate human evals. Natalie / Tom — let me know if you expect to run any load tests from your environment (we can mirror).

Best,
Vivek
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Natalie Liu <natalie.liu@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-09T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Acme Health POC / Evaluation Plan and Owners

Thanks, Marissa and Vivek — this looks good and tight. A few clarifications from our side:

- Timeline: the dates work but we need a hard demo slot on Mar 15 at 10am PT; can Redwood block that now?
- Data / prompts: Tom will own the prompt set; we can deliver 160 prompts by EOD Mar 9 (covers standard + high-risk items). He will also attach a small CSV with metadata tags (intent, sensitivity).
- Success criteria: product team will accept if human pass rate >= 80% (we can be flexible to 85% if latency and cost are within bounds). Hallucinations must be < 7% for high-risk prompts.
- Mode: we will test non-streaming first. If streaming looks beneficial for UX, we can evaluate later.

Tom and I will also include a short recording of our triage UX so you can replicate request patterns. Rafael — please follow up on the credit note we discussed.

I confirm: Natalie (PM, Acme) and Tom (data owner) are the acme leads. Vivek and Priya will be Redwood leads for tech and evals.

-Natalie
Product Manager | Acme Health
Natalie.Liu@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Liu <natalie.liu@acmehealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-09T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Acme Health POC / Evaluation Plan and Owners

Appreciate the fast turnaround, Natalie. Confirming the finalized owners and immediate actions:

Owners (finalized)
- Acme: Natalie Liu (PM) — demo acceptance, overall sign-off
- Acme: Tom Alvarez (Dataset/Prompts) — deliver 160 prompts + CSV tags by EOD 2026-03-09
- Redwood: Vivek Kulkarni (Tech Owner) — provide sample client, run model candidates, deliver baseline report by 2026-03-11
- Redwood: Priya Natarajan (CS) — coordinate human evals, collect reviewer notes, prepare demo script
- Redwood: Rafael Mendes (Commercial) — credits & contract follow-up

Immediate actions (today):
1) Tom: upload prompt CSV to the Drive folder and drop a quick note in HubSpot record 1234567 when done.
2) Vivek: post the sample client repo link to the Drive folder and confirm expected input payload sizes.
3) Marissa / Rafael: share POC credit note and finalize any IP/usage clarifications.

I'll schedule the Mar 15 demo at 10:00 AM PT and send a calendar invite once Rafael confirms commercial items.

If anything changes on delivery timing, flag here so we can shift resources. Thanks all — excited to get this running.

—
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
